environment.clock: time.perf_counter (QueryPerformanceCounter on Windows, system-wide) for latencies; time.time only for wall-clock notification delay
environment.endpoint_security: Not queried. Antivirus real-time scanning may add file I/O latency.

label_rule: A workload is labelled 'suspicious' when its design performs an unauthorized, ransomware-like impact: it replaces the original contents of at least three pre-existing fixture files with unrelated high-entropy bytes (in place, partially, or by writing a replacement and deleting the original) without keeping a recoverable copy. Every other workload is 'benign': it edits, copies, archives, appends or exports while preserving the user's data, or it is a transformation the user explicitly authorized. Labels come from this design rule, never from a CipherSentry score.
primary_criterion: Run is positive if any scored assessment in its observation window reaches High (score >= 75). Uncertain is reported separately.

workloads.label: benign
workloads.description: The user runs an authorized tool that encrypts disposable documents in place.

workloads.difficulty_notes: Intent-only difference from the suspicious overwrite family; an alert is the expected limitation.
